verdict.rationale: API versioning and deprecation policy are fair questions for an orchestration platform like Hatchet, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented versioned API contract and no deprecation policy. The '/v1/' documentation paths and the platform changelog only hint at versioning and are not a stated API versioning or deprecation commitment, and probes found no OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
